description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 03.06.2019 to 2019.06.09
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it is a statutory instrument setting official exchange rates for customs purposes.
